headline: France and Morocco on the up, Henry’s had a proper clobbering
text: Carolina’s France nicked it, Sara’s Morocco were all over Canada, and Chris edged Ghana to keep the points ticking. The bad news? Max’s Paraguay got mullered, so that was a flat one for him, and Henry’s Canada had a right going-over. Overall, Max is still best with 26 points, though Jack and Grandad are breathing down the necks. At the other end, Sofia is still bottom of the pile on 10, with Christopher not much happier on 11. A tidy little shake-up, but the table’s still got a familiar look about it.
